tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje btsun bden gnyis zhal gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// dpal rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo// he ru ka dpal thugs la zur mig mda'// 'phen mkhas chu zla'i gar gyis mi bcil ba'i// srid zhi'i mig 'phrul kun gyi byed pa mo// wā rā hī des bde legs mdzad gyur cig phag mo mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten nas| dpal sha wa ris rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang mdor bsdus pa gsungs pa bzhin/ slob dpon mai tri pa'i zhal skyin gyis cung zad spros te bshad par bya'o// sgrub thabs las byung ba bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor dbang rdzas kyi khar/ bum pa bzang po dar dmar pos mgul dkris pa/ rin po che/ sman/ 'bru/ dri/ snying po/ bdud rtsi lnga chus sum gnyis gang ba/ kha rgyan me tog dmar po dang ldan pa'i shing gis brgyan/ dbu rgyan/ rdor dril rnams stegs bu'i khar bzhag bdag mdun gyi bzlas pa'i bar gzhung bzhin byas nas/ bum par bcom ldan 'das ma bskyed pa nas/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin 'don pa cung zad bsgyur bar byas te/ me tog dmar po'i 'phreng ba dang ldan pa'i rdo rje bum pa'i khar bzhag snying po ji srid 'dod kyi bar du bzlas pas bskul nas/ me tog dmar po dor bas zhu nas bum pa'i chur blta'o// de nas snod du 'os pa'i slob ma ji snyed pa khrus byas gral la 'khod/ bla ma sangs rgyas dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i gus pas/ sems can thams cad kyi ched du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral te| bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phag mo'i go 'phang mngon par 'dod pa'i bsam pa bcangs la maṇ+ḍal byas/ ras dmar pos gdong bcings pa'i kha u rgyan du bltas te/ thal mo snying gar sbyar| me tog dmar pos dga' ba 'khyil ba bris pa'i steng du 'dug bgegs gtor/ oṃ a kā ro zhes pa nas/ me ri rab tu 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ ces bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bya/ de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyid nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces lan gsum gyis sems bskyed phog /slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi nang du zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na| dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar ma byed cig rdo rje snying gar bzhag nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// bdud rtsi byin nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha/ slar rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nga yin gyi| ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re| zhes dam bsgrags/ ye shes dbab pa'i phyir du/ bla ma rje btsun pa thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bdag la de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes bdud rtsi lta bus gang bar= smin par= yongs su= shin tu= lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas lus rnam par snang mdzad kyi skyil krung bcas/ rig pa skad cig kyang ma yengs par/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas rab tu brjid cing mdzes par bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bcom ldan 'das ma gsal btab/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sprin nam mkha'i khams gang ba spros pa slob ma la gnyis su med par thim/ lte 'og tu phag mo'i rang bzhin chos 'byung sor bzhi'i tshad tsam gdengs ka gyen du phyogs pa nang g.yung drung ris kyis brgyan pa kha dog dmar zhing reg bya tsha ba'i gtum mo shin tu rno ba'i zur can g.yon du 'khor ba dang smin mtshams su dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon du 'khor ba la dmigs nas nyams byung rgyal du btang ste/ bdug spos dang bcas pa'i rol mo drag tu bya/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ dza na ya/ ka na ya/ sa da ka ra yo ga yo gi nī ā be sha ya/ ā be sha ya/ hriṃ hriṃ he he hūm̐ hūm̐ phṭa ces brjod| 'dar ba dang*/ 'phar ba dang*/ ba spu ldang ba la sogs pa byung na phebs pa ste/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brtan par bya'o// de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor du phyogs pa la/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa ltar// bsod nams ji ltar de bzhin shog /'di yis dngos grub gang 'grub dang*// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ lha gang gi rigs brtag slar pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ mi maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ me tog gi 'phreng ba slob ma'i spyi bor bya ba ni/ de nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te| /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// ces mig dar phye/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyi// gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'di// mthong ba dang ni reg pa dang*// thos pa dang ni dran pa yis| /sdig pa kun las grol bar 'gyur// de ltar 'di la the tshom med// ces dkyil 'khor bstan par bya'o// dang po bum pa'i dbang ni/

sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma la ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// bdag ni byin gyis brlab tu gsol// byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod sbyin ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma bcom ldan 'das mar skad cig gis gsal btab nas bla ma'i snying ga'i 'od zer gyis mi bskyod pa la sogs pa he ru ka yab yum/ sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo khro mo dang bcas pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥde rnams kyis gur kum la sogs pa me tog gi char 'bebs shing*/ rol mor bcas pa'i glus mchod cing shis pa brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas tshigs su bcad pa 'di brjod bzhin pas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa gyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bum pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun nas rab bsgrub phyir// bum pa'i dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// byin gyis brlabs pa'i khu bas lus dang ngag dang yid kyi bdag nyid kyi 'khor lo gsum po bkrus nas rgyun chad med pa lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba las skyes pa'i dga' ba'i rgyun du ro gcig pas phung po lnga sangs rgyas lnga/ khams lnga yum lnga/ dbang yul sems dpa' sems ma/ las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa khro bo khro mor dag pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzugs su bzhengs par gyur/ spyi bor bla ma rnam par snang mdzad cod pan du 'ongs par mos te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi cod pan dbang*// de ring= sangs rgyas= cod pan dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// chos thams cad snying po nas snying por gyur pa'i dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje byin nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring= sangs rgyas= rdo rje'i dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// gzhom du med pa'i rlung yul rnams la 'jug pa'i sgra brnyan byin te/

sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*// de ring= sangs rgyas= dril bu'i dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// nam mkha' rdo rje 'chang ma khyod nyid ces bya ba'i ming btags te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang*// de ring= sangs rgyas= ming gi dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// nges pa don gyi rigs lnga'i dbang thob pa khyod nyid rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo ste/ bde ba chen po'i sems kyis rigs thams cad la kun tu spyod pa dang*/ brag cha lta bu'i gsung gis 'gro ba ma lus pa la chos ston pa dang*/ nam mkha' khyab pa sgyu ma'i gzugs kyis skal ba dang ldan pa thams cad nye bar sdus shig ces rdor dril phyag rgyar bca' la slob dpon du byed pa'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin no// gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ de nas sin+dhura'i bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa'i lcags kyus/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug ste bha gar zhugs pa dngul chu'i rnam pa can du zhu ba bcom ldan 'das ma'i chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma las babs pa'i rak+ta dang gcig tu 'dres pa'i thig le nyin mor byed pa lta bu spyi bo nas blugs pas lus ngag yid kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ye shes kyi me'i gzugs su bsregs te 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin du ro gcig pa sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i longs spyod rdzogs par sad pa'i mos pa gyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i dbang*// de ring= sangs rgyas= gsang ba'i dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// zhes thod pa'i chang 'thung du gzhug gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha mo zhu ba mtshams kyi sprin dang kha dog mtshungs par gyur pa'i sngags kyi 'khor lo slob ma'i spyi bo nas zhugs| a wa dhū ti'i lam nas brgyud de gsang gnas su rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo ltar 'khor zhing 'bar ba gsal btab ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi me long dbang*// de ring=

sangs rgyas= shes rab ye shes khyod kyis long*// slar yang phag gdong gi dpral bar g.yung drung ris dmar po 'khor bar bsam la srin po'i zhal cung zad bsdam/ badz+ra wā rā hi/ rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba khyod kyi snying la zhugs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs pa ni rdo rje khyod nyid de/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis kyis shigs pa med pa'i ye shes brtul zhugs kyi dam tshig gis mchod cig ces dbugs dbyung*/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha'i rang bzhin du khyod gyur bar| sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang ngas lung bstan no// zhes lung bstan/ bu khyod rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'i dus su khyod kyi drung du mchog tu gyur ba rnams lhags nas ba spu'i bu ga re re zhing nas sangs rgyas grangs med pa zhugs nas de nyid nas byung ste sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// zhes gzengs bstod/ sin+dhu ra phyis nas gnas gsum du thig le bya/ dbang bzhi pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba phyag rgya chen po'i don ji lta ba bzhin rtogs par byas la/ gang du yang gnas par mi bya'o// de yang brda sna tshogs kyi sgo nas rtogs par bya ste/ rdo rje gdan zhes brjod pa'i dus su sgra de la brten nas rdo rje gdan gyi don spyi wal gyis skye la/ yang 'phags pa shing kun zhes sgra brjod pas rdo rje gdan brjed nas 'phags pa shing kun gyi don spyi skye ba'o// dpe de bzhin du dang po ci yang mi dran pa ni/ mi rtog pa'i gnas su mnyam pa yin la/ rtog pa glo bur ba ni rkyen gyi dbang gis skye ba yin no// rtog pa phyi ma'i rkyen gyis snga ma brjed pa ni skye med ngang du thim pa'o// rigs kyi bu shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams mtha' yas pa thug pa med pa na phar song zhig

de bzhin du phyogs bzhi kar byas pas nam mkha' la thug pa med de mtha' dbus med par rtogs so// brda 'dis dbang bzhi po ro mnyam du rtogs par bya'o| /bla ma gong ma dag gsum po'ang lus ngag yid dag pa'i dbye bas bum gsang shes rab gsum du 'byed cing*/ bzhi pa shugs la bstan nas dgu phrugs su bzhed do// de nas ma da na dang*/ ba la gtso bor gyur pa'i tshogs kyi yo byad mtha' dag bshams/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod kyis bran la/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag sngon du 'gro bas byin rlabs zhus/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ tshogs rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥkha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ de nas gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlab/ ces pa nas/ dam tshig bskul ba'i bar byas/ las kyi rdo rjes tshogs phud cha lnga bshams nas/ gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro// reg bya 'dod yon rnam lnga 'di// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'bul// bde ba chen por bzhes su gsol// ga na tsakra pūdza khā hi/ dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs la 'bul// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul// gzhi bdag gnas bdag rnams la 'bul| /rol mo'i sgras nam mkhar gtor/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes phyag 'tshal te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs/ g.yon pas ka pā la dam tshig gis gang ba'i dpral ba slob dpon la bstan te bzung*/ g.yas pas pad kor bya zhing*/ 'di skad du/ kyai/ gzigs shig mdzes pa dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom bya mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// slob dpon gyis pad kor bya zhing*/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi mchog /'dod chags dri ma med pa 'di// gzung 'dzin rnam par grol ba yi// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// a ho su khaṃ/

zhes brjod cing*/ g.yon rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya snying gar bzhag la/ g.yas pas thod pa blang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi cho ga ltar dbul/ de nas btung*/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag byas/ de'i rjes la gzhan rnams la'ang tshul de nyid kyis drangs shing*/ mthar las kyi rdo rje la slob dpon gyis drangs/ phyag 'tshal zhing btung*/ de nas sha sngon du 'gro bas bza' bca' rnams drang zhing*/ rnam par rtog pa med par nang gi sbyin sreg gi nges pas longs spyod/ de'i tshe rdo rje'i glu dang gar dang*/ ye shes kyi kun tu ru'i spyod pa sogs bya/ mthar lhag ma bsdus pa dam tshig gi kha phrus btab/ sgron me btsugs te/ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ bhak+ṣe bh+yaḥswāhā/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po tshol ba la byin/ hūm̐ brjod pa'i me tog las kyi rdo rje'i spyi bor bzhag pas bsrungs te phyi rol du dor ro// rjes kyi cho ga gzhung bzhin du bya'o// de ltar rdo rje yan lag ma'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 'di ni/ ti se'i rdor 'dzin rdo rje bsam grub kyis ring mo nas bskul ba'i ngor/ pad+ma dkar pos rgyal byed tshal du sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ// //
